video_title: ‘A PERFECT FIT’ 🔥 Does LeBron make the Philadelphia 76ers championship FAVORITES? | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Bob Myers
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers pitches Philadelphia as LeBron James' best chance to win
quotes.excerpt: I honestly believe this is your best chance to win.
quotes.quote: If he was here, I'd say I honestly believe this is your best chance to win. You have to decide all the other things that are equally important. What I would just say is, if it's about winning, and let's talk about this team, because you can win here in Philadelphia.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James prioritized winning a championship in 2027 over other factors
quotes.excerpt: If LeBron's number one priority was winning the championship in 2027, that seems like a basic thing.
quotes.quote: I think what Bob Myers said is exactly correct. I think if LeBron's number one priority was winning the championship in 2027, and that seems like a basic thing that you'd want to do as a star player as a free agent, but that was not what we were told. We were told he was chasing basketball happiness and left to guess for a month with that meant. We now find out that basketball happiness to LeBron was having a chance to win the title in year one because he's not sure how long he's going to be able to play.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert praises LeBron James' decision to join the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: If this is about winning, which I know LeBron to be a winner, I think this gives him the best chance.
quotes.quote: I loved to see that he went there because if this is about winning, which I know LeBron to be a winner from being in the days in Cleveland, if it's about winning, I think this gives him the best chance. You look at Jaylen Brown, who is somebody that carried a Boston team that nobody saw going to be in the running, carried them all through the East. Now understanding that if he's going to take a backseat to anyone, why not take a backseat to LeBron James' mind?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' pre-existing relationship with Tyrese Maxey influenced his decision
quotes.excerpt: Part of I think the reason he chose Philadelphia was his pre-existing relationship with Tyrese Maxey.
quotes.quote: It already started because LeBron's had multiple conversations with Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey. I believe he's also had a conversation with head coach Nick Nurse to talk about what it's going to look like. Part of I think the reason he chose Philadelphia was his pre-existing relationship with Tyrese Maxey. If you're going to pick a team that's going to have issues sharing the ball and massaging egos, you want to have a strong relationship with the point guard.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Negandhi
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Negandhi compares current 76ers roster to 1983 championship team
quotes.excerpt: My favorite 76ers team of all time was 1983 when the 76ers won it all.
quotes.quote: My favorite 76ers team of all time was 1983 when the 76ers won it all and they had to bring in Moses. Immediately when I thought of this LeBron James thing off the Jaylen Brown trade, it was like you need some help and Joel Embiid has needed help for quite some time. They tried to pair him up of course in the past with Ben Simmons, then James Harden, then the emergence of Tyrese Maxey. Now the idea that they have Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, and now Tyrese Maxey and VJ Edgecombe, it just helps a guy like Joel Embiid.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin discusses LeBron James' legacy and championship goals in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: LeBron gets to go to a sports-obsessed city with a chance not just to win a championship.
quotes.quote: What it means for LeBron is he gets to go to a sports-obsessed city with a chance not just to win a championship, and all championships are special, but not all championships are created equal. The 2008 Philadelphia championship, erasing a 25-year drought for the city of Philadelphia in terms of all pro sports championships, was as special as it gets. LeBron already erased a 52-year championship drought with the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2016. If he can erase a 43-year drought for the franchise of the 76ers, that will carry a little bit more weight.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin credits Tyrese Maxey for LeBron James' arrival in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: The current 76er, you got to give credit to Tyrese Maxey.
quotes.quote: If you want to go way back, you can point to Moses Malone, one of LeBron's first mentors. Before LeBron played his first NBA game in Sacramento on the road with the Cavaliers, he got lunch in a hotel in Sacramento with Moses Malone. But the current 76er, you got to give credit to Tyrese Maxey. LeBron's been working out with Tyrese over the last several summers. They're both represented by Rich Paul and Klutch Sports. You think about what LeBron was able to win with in 2016 with a great guard that could take the ball and do many things in Kyrie Irving, he can kind of replicate that style of play.
